📈 HighLow

A card is shown — predict whether the next card will be higher or lower. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. A card is shown — predict if the next card will be Higher or Lower.
  2. Aces count as 14 (highest), making extremes more likely.
  3. If the next card is equal, you usually lose the streak.
  4. Build consecutive correct streaks for score multipliers.
  5. When in doubt, bet on the side with more cards remaining in the deck.
